backend: DuckDB1.5.5 with Quack c154811 on mirrored OpenZFS2.2.2
operations: exact acknowledged recent and historical point reads
consistency: Each remote SQL statement executes inside the single DuckDB owner. Readers require exact bodies of already acknowledged immutable keys. This is not a general linearizability or SQL isolation-anomaly qualification.
atomicity: One INSERT SELECT statement per uniquely identified batch; zero or all expected rows may be present after an ambiguous response.
idempotency: No mutation retries. Each new attempt gets a disjoint ID range; failed or ambiguous ranges are retained and reconciled.
durability: Native default DuckDB WAL synchronization and ZFS sync=standard. Retained virtual-disk guest power-cut recovery must lose zero acknowledged rows. No claim about physical host power-loss durability.
retry_policy: http_retries=0; http_timeout=3 seconds. Persistent native client instances are discarded after errors; fresh connection establishment is attempted for new requests. No server-side dedup assumption. Administrative seed/export uses300 seconds, separately recorded; this does not change live-operation deadlines.
data: Deterministic IDs, customer=id%customers, amount=id%10000+1,64-character lowercase SHA256 of decimal ID, batch start/end. No nulls. SQL generates payloads; this is not application-byte upload throughput.
topology: One active primary QEMU guest(2CPU/3GiB container;2vCPU/1536MiB guest;512MB DuckDB;256MiB ZFS ARC). Provisioned standby is stopped and does not replicate this profile's table. Workload controller has2CPU/1GiB, swap disabled.

expected_phases.baseline: Independent readers and all writer processes remain alive; require observed successful reads and writes before injection.
expected_phases.fault: QMP quit stops the exact owned QEMU process. Host verifies stopped Docker runtime state and PID0, then holds at least5 seconds before restarting it. Readers and writers continue submitting; errors/ambiguous outcomes are expected.
expected_phases.native-recovery: Same owned disks reopen on a changed guest boot ID. Pool is healthy and native DuckDB WAL recovery finishes. Actors retain process identity and reconnect. Effective zfs_arc_max and c_max must remain268435456 bytes after boot and after owner startup; drift fails qualification.
expected_phases.recovered: Require new successful reads/writes for at least10 seconds. Reconcile all2m seed rows and every attempted/acknowledged batch, with zero wrong, partial, duplicate or missing acknowledged rows. Re-export and independently reconcile earlier same-dataset case tables before cleanup.
expected_phases.configuration: Persist256MiB ZFS ARC option in the owned guest module configuration/initramfs and service pre-start hook; verify effective maximum before any workload. Record stable dataset GUID and retain prior same-dataset case tables.

limits: One host and shared Docker storage
Functional co-tenancy permitted and recorded; no capacity ranking
No replicated HA, disk-loss, partition, pressure, SQL mutation/isolation or restore qualification in this profile
